name: claude-code-windows-kit
description: Small Windows quality-of-life plugins for Claude Code: native toast notifications and an always-on-top usage-limit widget.

plugins.name: toast-notify
plugins.description: Native Windows toast notification whenever Claude Code needs your permission or is waiting for input.

plugins.name: usage-widget
plugins.description: Always-on-top Windows widget showing your Claude session and weekly usage limits, color-coded by how much is used.
